In the old dzone, doing 10 waves would give you same score/reward as doing 5 waves in a higher difficulty because the gap between difficulties was 25 points but with the new changes, the gap is 50 points meaning doing 5 extra clears will only give half of the rewards from the higher difficulty.

So many accounts are build around doing 10 waves since it's less stressful and it encourages team building with less popular Awakeners which for many people is more fun than struggling on higher difficulties with units they don't have fun with.

content:
<@1487626955791663208> ～ Light I know a game is hard to balance, and a gacha is even worse since it has to keep up in time with the fun, what you concede to player base and how much money you need to bring with the features.
But:
      Since this game is your baby and since the community is really picky, and is kinda doom posting right away after seeing each announcement without even waiting to see how the actual thing feels.
- I was wondering what is the mind state of the dev team when you choose to make those announcements.
- Do you think people will like it, or are you counting on the feedbacks to actually make the tweaks in order to please the most part of the community?
- When you plan those updates on the game, have you tested it and found it more fun to play, or does it serve another purpose?
- Does the team just want to test here and there new adjustments and see the result on player's gameplay experience?
- Do you have any player test people that are close to the gamer's game experience to relate to and say " yeah, this new feature is making the game even more fun/addictive and will bring more people in " ?

Thanks for answering : )
